title: LTA's Planning Assumptions for Traffic Impact on Singapore Roads
what_it_is: LTA's Planning Assumptions for Traffic Impact on Singapore Roads

sections.label: Transport impact assessments for developments
sections.summary: LTA requires developers to conduct transport impact assessments for new and redeveloped sites to identify road network impact and recommend mitigating measures.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Lam Pin Min) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: LTA requires developers to conduct transport impact assessments (TIAs) to identify the impact of new developments and redevelopments on the surrounding road network and recommend mitigating measures.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Lam Pin Min) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: This applies to both new and mature estates.

sections.label: Vehicle scenarios in assessments
sections.summary: LTA does not require the TIA to consider vehicle population scenarios, but factoring in the zero vehicle growth rate and public transport enhancements accounts for reduced private car usage.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Lam Pin Min) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: LTA does not require the TIA to consider a range of vehicle population scenarios, nor for a specific car-lite scenario.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Lam Pin Min) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: However, by factoring in the vehicle growth rate, which is currently zero for non-commercial vehicles, and enhancements to public transport and active mobility infrastructure in the vicinity, the developments will account for a reduction in the usage of private cars over time.

sections.label: Possible transport improvement measures
sections.summary: Possible measures include staging developments to prevent traffic demand surges or road widening, and encouraging public transport and active mobility.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: Some of these possible transport improvement measures will include staging the developments to prevent a surge in traffic demand or road widening whenever possible and also to encourage the use of public transport and active mobility modes of transport.

sections.label: Silver Zones implementation
sections.summary: 15 Silver Zones have been implemented, and the number will increase to 50 by 2023.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: To update the Member, we have implemented 15 Silver Zones over the years.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: We will increase the number of Silver Zones to 50 by 2023.
